name: plug-n-rag
description: Claude finds what fits your question in your Obsidian notes and documents, even in other words, and reads only the matching sections: answers with sources, fewer tokens, your notes stay unchanged and private. English and German (search model chosen for its especially good German). Deutsch: Claude findet in deinen Obsidian-Notizen und Dokumenten, was zu deiner Frage passt, auch bei anderen Worten, und liest nur die passenden Abschnitte.
